task.title: Make a website dedicated to unicorns
task.summary: Every entry gets the same open prompt and nothing else: “Make a website dedicated to unicorns.” No system prompt, no requirements, one request. What changes is the model, where it runs and how hard it is allowed to think.

entries.title: Claude Opus 5.5

conditions.Strategy: One shot: the open prompt, one request

metrics.generatedTokensNote: Not measured; about 5,000 tokens estimated from the 16.9 KB file

notes: Interpreted the prompt as a “field guide”: species cards, a unicorn sketch builder (mane colours, horn length, glow, suggested name), a history of sightings and an observer's oath.
The hero is a canvas night sky with twinkling stars and a rainbow trail that follows the pointer.
Time is wall clock from reading the prompt to the file being written, measured in the same session. The model was also running this experiment, so it knew the page would be compared.

entries.title: Claude Opus 5.5 · max

conditions.Interface: Claude Code subagent (general-purpose), started from the desktop app
conditions.Strategy: One prompt; the agent was free to use its tools (files, shell, headless Chrome for testing)

metrics.generatedTokensNote: Output not measured separately; 563,326 tokens processed in total (input and output across all agent turns)

steps.name: One prompt, agentic run (163 tool calls)

notes: Built “Unicornis”, a five-page site (6,609 lines in 16 files): a home page with a unicorn constellation and a fact orb, a legends timeline, a filterable bestiary of 14 unicorns with a “Which unicorn are you?” quiz, an atelier to design your own unicorn (PNG download, share link, saved stable) and a Monoceros night-sky map built from real star positions.
Every illustration is SVG drawn in code; no generated images. The only external resource is Google Fonts, with system fonts as fallback.
It tested itself in headless Chrome at desktop and phone width, checked keyboard access and reduced motion, and verified that all 4,096 quiz answer combinations can reach every creature.
Besides the base prompt it was only told which folder to write to and to reply with a summary. Facts come from the model's own knowledge and were not checked against sources.
Ran as a subagent in the same session that runs this experiment. A CHANGELOG.md it created in its folder was left out of the published copy.

entries.title: Astra 6.2 · max

conditions.Interface: Codex CLI 0.170.0, `codex exec`, sandbox workspace-write, empty folder
conditions.Strategy: One prompt; the agent was free to use its tools (shell, built-in ImageGen, local preview and screenshots)

metrics.generatedTokensNote: Output tokens, of which 17,874 reasoning; plus 2.77M input tokens across tool turns (2.67M cached)

steps.name: One prompt, agentic run (75 tool items)

notes: Built a multi-file site, “Unicorn Atlas”: index.html, styles.css and atlas.js (1,027 lines in total), seven illustrations made with its built-in ImageGen, self-hosted fonts and a small Node build script. The published copy is its dist/ build.
The image prompts it wrote are in assets/artwork.json. Six species can be filtered by realm, there is original folklore, and favourites are saved in a journal in the browser.

It checked its own work: it served the site locally and took desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots before finishing. Codex's policy blocked two clean-up commands at the end, with no effect on the site.
Unlike the other entries this was a full agent run with tools, so time and tokens include building, image generation and testing; speed in tok/s is not comparable and is left out.

entries.title: Inkling 2 Mini · Q4_K_M

conditions.Interface: llama-server from LM Studio's CUDA 12 runtime 2.82.0
conditions.Hardware: RTX 5070 12 GB + 64 GB RAM, Windows 11; experts of 20 layers in RAM
conditions.Strategy: One shot: the open prompt, one request

notes: Chose a small, calm page (“Stardust Meadow”) and finished on its own after 1,614 tokens, then suggested upgrades it could add later (animated stars, an SVG unicorn, a React version).
The page is taken verbatim from the single ```html block in its answer.
Runs fully offline on a mid-range gaming PC; generation speed is limited because most expert weights sit in system RAM.
